notes.title: Flag Skin Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New free skin[/h1][p]The flag skin is a free skin that is available for everyone, after selecting the skin you can choose between 267 different flags.[/p][p][/p][h1]Changelog[/h1][list][*][p]Added a new wheel and a new spark skin in the shop; check it out![/p][/*][*][p]Added a new free skin, the flag skin[/p][/*][*][p]Added a short text to explain trigger spawning in the help panel in the editor[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Unreal to version 5.6.1 (sorry for the large update size)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed default render engine to DX12 (let me know if you encounter any issue regarding this)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mouse lag introduced in the last update[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all mouse related performance issues[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for a lot more languages for players name, map names and online chat[/p][/*][*][p]You can now visualize spark skins in the shop and customization screen by hovering a spark skin[/p][/*][*][p]You can now rotate the wheel in the shop and customization screen by either moving your mouse over the wheel or using the camera look analog input (right stick by default) on controller[/p][/*][*][p]Various small fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Here is what the new 15 credits skin looks like:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718479/b842bab7d035c01302dc28c8aed1734b3e6b3bd7.png"][/img][/p][h1]What's coming next[/h1][p]I'm currently putting the official campaign on hold to work on a track generator. My goal with that is to implement a new game mode; Survival. In Survival you start with a certain amount of time on a decreasing timer. Every time you manage to finish a randomly generated map, an amount of time is added to your timer. The tracks get longer and longer; your goal is to finish the most maps you can before your timer runs out. The track generator will be available in the editor, the seed and track segment count will be displayed in every track you play in survival, so if you find a track you like, you will be able to recreate it in the editor and upload it for others to play. Since Survival won't have individual leaderboards, I'm thinking that pausing will actually pause gameplay in that mode. I'll see if I can get it working for next week!
As always, feel free to tell me what you think in the discord![/p]

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.notes: [h2]Tutorial[/h2][list][*][p]You can now choose between tutorial and browse when playing solo[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 introduction maps with explanations for new players[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other changes[/h2][list][*][p]Bunch of bug fixes for the editor[/p][/*][*][p]New low-level mouse handling to support high polling rate[/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 new environment; swamp[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 new themed asset categories; future and fractal[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Next to come[/h2][p]I'll get started on the official campaign, it will feature 15 new maps divided into 3 difficulties.[/p][p]I'll also work on adding more free customization options.[/p][p]Feel free to suggest additional features or fixes in the discord![/p]

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]It's been a week since launch; thank you for all the support, feedback and enthusiasm.[/p][p]Rest assured, this is only the beginning, my vision for the Gradient Flow is far greater.[/p][p]Here is the roadmap for what's to come:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718479/ca9fe47f9ff4a97097c047b914ae584e94193f85.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Short-term:[/h2][p]The game currently has almost nothing to guide new players. To address this, I'm implementing an easily expandable tutorial system. It will feature custom tracks that will first teach all the controls, then go into detail on the different driving mechanics.[/p][p]I will also start working on a new official campaign, it will feature achievements based on the medals obtained. A global leaderboard based on performance would be nice too.[/p][h2]Medium-term:[/h2][p]The short-term changes should add a fair amount of content for new players, but we could still do better. I have a couple of ideas in that direction but I need to see if I can make it work before talking about them. If you have any ideas for fun activities, in the context of solo play, feel free to reach out to us on our discord![/p][p]Also, the current camera system is nice while driving, but is pretty useless in the air. I want to fix that with a camera system that will allow you to control the camera behavior, the goal is to have user-defined camera presets that you can then switch between in-game.[/p][p]Online multiplayer in its current state is very limited, I want to do a lot there, but the player base is not really at a point where it makes sense to focus on it. To give you an idea on what to expect once we get there, I want to work on a way for users to make their own multiplayer game modes through some form of scripting.[/p][h2]Long-term:[/h2][p]The long-term vision is to move toward a seasonal structure. This would give players a great reason to come back to check the new season, I have a bunch of ideas for future seasons. Each season would likely feature;[/p][list][*][p]New game mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]A new official campaign featuring those mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]New assets for map creation[/p][/*][*][p]Additional player skins[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]That's it for now! Thanks again for being part of this journey so early on. If you have feedback or questions feel free to reach out on our discord for anything, I'm more than happy to give tips and tricks, be it for driving or for making maps![/p]

notes.title: Closed beta is here
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
We just launched a closed beta of Gradient Flow and we currently have 50 keys for that beta.
To get one Steam key feel free to contact us(the full game will still be fully free, it's only for closed beta access).
It can be activated like any other Steam key (Games > Activate a product on Steam).
Nothing is expected from beta testers but we would really like to have feedback. 
The big new thing of that beta is the map editor, feel free to experiment with it, you can now create your own maps.

Disclaimer: current version of the beta may be quite unstable and have bugs, expect to see them.
There is no NDA on that beta, feel free to talk about it with other people or to create content with it.
More features will come soon.

List of changes already in the beta:
Map editor
You can upload and research maps
You can now have multiple replays
VR is supported (but without motion control)

Multiplayer should be the next big update of the beta.

Find us on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2457200/Gradient_Flow/

Support us on Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/impeyrongames/gradient-flow/description

notes.title: Kickstarter start to finish the funding of the game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
After all this time we are finally on the last straight line until Gradient Flow release. 
Demo is here since the last Next Fest.
Alpha version is coming by the end of the month.
And while we are finishing and polishing the game mechanics and the code of the game we are still missing one thing before full release: cosmetics.
Sadly our team artist isn't currently available at all so we are launching a crowdfunding to raise funds to hire one artist to do them for us. 
We expect to have the game technically finished by Augustus so it's a bit more like a preorder for you while it helps us by paying the artist for us.

Even something small can help us greatly.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/impeyrongames/gradient-flow

notes.title: Added Pause Menu + Some Fixes
notes.notes:
-Added pause menu, it doesn't actual pause the gameplay for competitive reasons (you could slow time with an AHK script)
-Added mouse smoothing setting
-Added sections in the input settings

-Fixed a physics bug that only happens on one specific road section by increasing the bounding box of sections slightly, it shouldn't affect anything else but let me know if you encounter some collision bugs (ex: your ghost doesn't reach the finish line anymore)

notes.title: Some improvements
notes.notes:
-Changed the way different inputs interact; rather than take the greatest magnitude their sum is used instead, simplifying the code and allowing for interesting combination of control schemes
-Remade most of the menu UI to be more consistent
-When exiting a track you are now presented with the track list
-I'm aware of a bug that makes the medium track list not select-able with controller before going in a race and coming back, oddly specific, sorry about that
-Removed medal requirement for track, it was just an anti-fun mechanic that's not going to be in the full game anyway, sorry that it was there in the first place

notes.title: Next Fest end and roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the Steam Next Fest ended but don't worry, our demo isn't going anywhere.
Our demo will stay as basically public "early access" until the full release of our game and we'll keep updating it.

We want to thanks all of you who tried our game and enjoyed it.
On top of that we want to do some special thanks to the players who fought to take those top 1 from Vivi, it was really nice to see you all sharing your tips to try to find the perfect path and I'm sure there will be even more of that in the future.

You'll find our roadmap with our objectives until our closed alpha and then until our game release.
Obviously game release won't be the end of our support for the game.

Thanks again to all of you and may the odds be with you on the tracks.
